subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

VIGILANT
solution:
The correct answer is: Inattentive

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Vigilant means alertly watchful especially to avoid danger.

 
 
• Example - *Security personnel need to be more **vigilant **in checking bags and packages.*

 
 
 
 
• Marked option Inattentive means not paying complete attention to a person or thing, which often causes an accident or problems.
 
 
• Example - *One **inattentive **student can disturb the whole class.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Vigilant' and 'Inattentive' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Wary means careful because you are uncertain or afraid of somebody/something.
 
• Cautious means taking great care to avoid possible danger or problems.
 
• Careful means giving a lot of attention to details to be sure something is right.
